name: cfslider
description:
Used inside cfform, cfslider lets you place a slider control in a CFML form. A slider
control is like a sliding volume control. The slider groove is the area over which the slider moves.

params.name: name
params.description: A name for the cfslider control.

params.name: label
params.description: A label that displays with the slider control.

params.name: refreshLabel
params.description: Yes or No. If Yes, the label is not refreshed when the slider is moved. Default is Yes.

params.name: range
params.description:
The values of the left and right slider range. The slider value displays as the slider is moved.
Separate values by a comma.

params.name: scale
params.description: Unsigned integer. Defines the slider scale within the value of range.

params.name: value
params.description:
The starting slider setting. Must be within the values specified in range. Defaults to the
minimum value specified in range.

params.name: onValidate
params.description:
The name of a valid JavaScript function used to validate user input; in this case,
a change to the default slider value.

params.name: message
params.description: Message text to appear if validation fails.

params.name: onError
params.description: The name of a valid JavaScript function to execute in the event of a failed validation.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the slider control, in pixels.

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the slider control, in pixels.

params.name: vSpace
params.description: Vertical margin spacing above and below slider control, in pixels.

params.name: hSpace
params.description: Horizontal margin spacing to the left and right of slider control, in pixels.

params.name: align
params.description: Alignment value.

params.name: tickMarkMajor
params.description: Yes to render major tickmarks in the slider scale.

params.name: tickMarkMinor
params.description: Yes to render minor tickmarks in the slider scale.

params.name: tickMarkImages
params.description: image used for tickmarks

params.name: tickMarkLabels
params.description: label used for tickmarks

params.name: lookAndFeel
params.description: A stylistic choice for the slider.

params.name: vertical
params.description:
Yes renders the slider in the browser vertically. No renders the slider horizontally.

This is the default.

params.name: bgColor
params.description: Background color of slider label. See textColor for color options.

params.name: textColor
params.description:
Slider label text color. Valid entries are: black, magenta,
cyan, orange, darkgray, pink, gray, white, lightgray, yellow.

params.name: font
params.description: Font name for label text.

params.name: fontSize
params.description: Font size for label text measured in points.

params.name: italic
params.description: Yes for italicized label text, No for normal text. Default is No.

params.name: bold
params.description: Enter Yes for bold label text, No for medium text. Default is No.

params.name: notSupported
params.description:
The text to display if a page containing a Java applet-based cfform control is opened by a
browser that does not support Java or has Java support disabled.
